Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1).CodeModule.AddFromString Replace("Function F(a, b)\n    F = a + b\nEnd Function\nSub S()\nEnd Sub\n", "\n", vbCrLf)
    wb.Activate
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="Adds two"
    Case 1
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Category:=5
    Case 2
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", HasShortcutKey:=True, ShortcutKey:="q"
    Case 3
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", Description:="Does it", HasShortcutKey:=True, ShortcutKey:="Q"
    Case 4
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="Adds", Category:=14
    Case 5
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", HelpContextID:=7
    Case 6
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="x": Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:=""
    Case 7
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="d", HelpContextID:=3, Category:=2
    Case 8
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="Module1.F", Description:="d"
    Case 9
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="Zzz", Description:="d"
    Case 10
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", HasShortcutKey:=True, ShortcutKey:="q": Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", Description:="later"
    Case 11
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", HasShortcutKey:=True, ShortcutKey:="q": Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", HasShortcutKey:=False
    Case 12
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Category:=5: Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="d"
    Case 13
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", ShortcutKey:="q"
    Case 14
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", HasShortcutKey:=True
    Case 15
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Category:=0
    Case 16
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Category:=40
    Case 17
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F"
    Case 18
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="say ""hi"""
    Case 19
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", HasShortcutKey:=True, ShortcutKey:="ab"
    Case 20
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="F", Description:="d": wb.VBProject.VBComponents("Module1").CodeModule.InsertLines 1, "Dim top As Long"
    Case 21
        Application.MacroOptions Macro:="S", Description:="d": wb.VBProject.VBComponents("Module1").CodeModule.DeleteLines 1, 3
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & wb.VBProject.VBComponents("Module1").CodeModule.CountOfLines
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsm", xlOpenXMLWorkbookMacroEnabled
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 21
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
